plan.title: Treated vs control lung RNA-seq, batch-confounded
plan.analytical_narrative:
The inputs are a 12,000 gene x 12 sample raw salmon count matrix (counts.csv, gene symbols in column 1) and a 12 x 3 sample table (metadata.csv) with condition and batch, human lung. The design is 6 treated vs 6 control, and the profile records that batch B1 holds all 6 controls and batch B2 holds all 6 treated samples. Batch is therefore perfectly aliased with condition: the model matrix ~ batch + condition is rank-deficient, and any removal method (ComBat-seq, removeBatchEffect, SVA/RUV) would delete the treatment effect together with the batch effect. Following the knowledge-service flag R-0005, the plan fits condition alone, does NOT attempt batch correction, and labels every downstream result as confounded — the reported gene-level differences are the sum of treatment and processing-batch effects and cannot be separated with this design.

T1S1 runs the standard structure QC on raw counts (blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes), coloured by condition and by batch; because the two labels coincide, the PCA cannot adjudicate between them, and the step's job is to detect outlier samples and depth problems, not to demonstrate a treatment effect. T1S2 does the minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), median-of-ratios normalisation inside the model, the DESeq2 Wald test for condition treated vs control with the reference level set explicitly to control, apeglm shrinkage of the reported log2 fold change, and BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering on. T1S2b repeats the same contrast with the edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered counts and reports the overlap with DESeq2 as the high-confidence set (R-0042); at n=6 per group the two agree on most genes and the disagreement is informative. T2S1 takes the full ranked list of tested genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (the stated choice for the disputed ranking metric, R-0108) into fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark human 2026.1, then Reactome and human WikiPathways as separate collections with their releases stated. T1S3 assembles the report with the MA and dispersion plots, the p-value histogram, the shrunken and unshrunken fold changes with lfcSE, the leading-edge genes per significant set, the reproducibility record, and — first, before any gene list — the confounding statement.

The honest limit of this analysis: with batch nested inside condition, no statistical procedure recovers a treatment-specific estimate. The output is a ranked list of genes that differ between the two processing batches, one of which received the treatment. It is a hypothesis-generating list, not evidence of a treatment effect, and the report must say so.

Ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic, and this choice is stated in the output
Hallmark, Reactome (human-filtered) and WikiPathways human are each tested separately with min set size 15 and max 500 among tested genes; results are never pooled across collections
Release/version of each gene set collection and the unmapped symbol share per collection are reported

Significant sets per collection at BH-adjusted p < 0.05 are reported with NES, adjusted p, set size and leading-edge genes; redundant sets are collapsed to representatives with the full table kept as a supplement
Size of the padj<0.05 gene list from T1S2 is stated; if it is under ~50 genes no ORA is run and the reason is stated
All enrichment output carries the confounded label
constraints: enrichment: gsea_input = full ranked list; do not threshold before ranking
enrichment: rank_metric = stat (DESeq2 Wald statistic) — stated choice on the disputed metric; not the unshrunken log2FC alone, not a signed p-value with ties
enrichment: min_size = 15, max_size = 500 applied after intersecting each set with the tested genes
enrichment: universe = tested genes; never the whole genome or annotation
enrichment: collapse_redundant = true, one representative per overlapping group
enrichment: each collection tested and reported separately with its release stated; do not merge collections into one set list
enrichment: if fewer than 50 genes pass padj<0.05, do not run an over-representation test — the ranked test on the full list stands in
Set and record a random seed for the fgsea permutations
caveats: Gene length and expression level bias enrichment on count data; the tested-gene universe removes only the detection part of that bias
Enrichment results are method-dependent — a set is a hypothesis for follow-up, not a proven finding
Every enriched set here describes the combined treatment-plus-batch contrast and must be reported as such

grounding.reason: Human dataset after a DESeq2 contrast: fgsea preranked on the Wald statistic against Hallmark first, then Reactome and WikiPathways as separate collections (R-0107, R-0048, R-0098, R-0165); disputed metric R-0108 resolved in favour of the Wald statistic and stated.

steps.name: Confounded-design report
steps.question: What can and cannot be concluded about treated vs control lung expression from a design where batch B2 holds every treated sample and B1 every control?
steps.description: Assemble the final report. Open with the design limitation before any gene list: batch is perfectly confounded with condition, no batch term was fitted, no batch-removal method was applied, and the reported differences are treatment and processing batch combined. Then give the method, package versions, design formula, contrast (condition, treated over control), thresholds, number of genes tested after filtering, and number of DE genes per method. Include the MA plot and the dispersion plot from the DESeq2 fit and the p-value histogram. Give the gene table with unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE, ranked and plotted on the shrunken value, with p-values from the unshrunken fit. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap from T1S2b as the high-confidence set. Report the enrichment results from T2S1 with the database, its release, the ranking metric, the universe, the size window, and the leading-edge genes per reported set, marking leading-edge overlaps between sets. Close with the reproducibility record: sessionInfo, package versions, the seed used for the fgsea permutations, and the version of each gene set collection. State what would resolve the confounding: samples from both conditions processed in each batch, or a technical replicate bridging B1 and B2.
steps.context: The deliverable answers the user's question — which genes differ between treated and control — while making the interpretive ceiling of the design explicit rather than burying it.
acceptance_criteria: The confounding statement appears before any gene list or pathway result, in plain language
Report names the method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, number of tested genes and number of DE genes per method
MA plot, dispersion plot and p-value histogram are included with a one-line reading of each
Gene table carries unshrunken log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE; ranking and plots use the shrunken value
DESeq2 vs edgeR counts and intersection size are reported, with the intersection named as the high-confidence set
Enrichment section states database, release, rank metric, universe, size window, and lists leading-edge genes per reported set with overlaps marked
Reproducibility record with sessionInfo, package versions, seed and collection versions is stored with the results
Report states concretely what design change would make the treatment effect estimable
constraints: report: fit diagnostics = MA plot and dispersion plot
report: effect columns = log2FoldChange, shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE; rank genes by the shrunken value
report: robustness = overlap of DESeq2 and edgeR QL
report: leading edge listed per significant set
report: reproducibility record = sessionInfo, seed, package versions, collection versions
State the enrichment method-dependence caveat
Do not describe any result as a treatment effect without the batch qualifier
caveats: No statistical statement in this report distinguishes treatment from batch; that limit is structural and must not be softened
A gene called by both methods is robustly different between B1 and B2 — that is a statement about the contrast, not about causation by the treatment

grounding.reason: Report content follows the reporting rules R-0041/R-0085/R-0087/R-0051/R-0105/R-0086, plus the R-0005 requirement that every result be labelled confounded.
